text: neurothresh_null_spec S3 class with stat_vol/mask/draw/n_perm/df/kind/meta. New design-facing factories: null_voxel_signflip, null_one_sample, null_subject_signflip (alias of one_sample), null_two_sample (with levels= and contrast=), null_glm, null_mc_fwhm, null_mc_acf, null_parcel_perm. Smoothness inputs accept smoothness_fwhm()/smoothness_acf() objects (with numeric back-compat). make_null_fun_subject_signflip() is now a thin shim around null_one_sample (deterministic-by-index, retiring lazy variant). Tests 22/22 on null-spec, 346/346 full suite.
